Credit reports contain a range of information—everything from personal details like names and Social Security numbers to specifics about auto loan payments and repossessions. It gives a view of your overall credit and debt history, like how often you make payments on time, how much credit you have, and how much credit you're using. Reviewing credit reports helps lenders decide if they will loan money to you and what interest rates and other terms they will offer.
